title: Self-EvolveRec: Self-Evolving Recommender Systems with LLM-based Directional Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2602.12612v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Traditional methods for automating recommender system design, such as Neural Architecture Search (NAS), are often constrained by a fixed search space defined by human priors, limiting innovation to pre-defined operators. While recent LLM-driven code evolution frameworks shift fixed search space target to open-ended program spaces, they primarily rely on scalar metrics (e.g., NDCG, Hit Ratio) that fail to provide qualitative insights into model failures or directional guidance for improvement. To address this, we propose Self-EvolveRec, a novel framework that establishes a directional feedback loop by integrating a User Simulator for qualitative critiques and a Model Diagnosis Tool for quantitative internal verification. Furthermore, we introduce a Diagnosis Tool - Model Co-Evolution strategy to ensure that evaluation criteria dynamically adapt as the recommendation architecture evolves. translated_title: Self-EvolveRec：基于大语言模型方向性反馈的自演化推荐系统
translated_abstract: 传统的推荐系统设计自动化方法，如神经架构搜索（NAS），通常受限于由人类先验知识定义的固定搜索空间，使创新局限于预定义的算子。尽管近期基于大语言模型（LLM）驱动的代码演化框架将目标从固定搜索空间转向了开放式程序空间，但它们主要依赖标量指标（如NDCG、Hit Ratio），无法为模型失败提供定性洞察，也无法为改进提供方向性指导。为解决这一问题，我们提出了Self-EvolveRec，一种通过整合用于定性批评的用户模拟器和用于定量内部验证的模型诊断工具来建立方向性反馈回路的新型框架。此外，我们引入了诊断工具-模型协同演化策略，以确保评估标准能够随着推荐架构的演化而动态适应。大量实验表明……
tldr: 提出了Self-EvolveRec框架，通过用户模拟器的定性批评与模型诊断工具的定量验证构建方向性反馈回路，并引入诊断工具与模型协同演化策略，使推荐系统能够实现自我演化改进。
en_tdlr: Self-EvolveRec establishes a directional feedback loop for self-evolving recommender systems by integrating a User Simulator for qualitative critiques and a Model Diagnosis Tool for quantitative verification, with a Diagnosis Tool-Model Co-Evolution strategy to dynamically adapt evaluation criteria.
